learning_outcomes.text: Possess sufficient background in mathematics, science, and engineering subjects related to their field; use theoretical and applied knowledge in these areas together for Electrical-Electronics Engineering solutions.
Identify, define, formulate, and solve Electrical-Electronics Engineering problems; select and apply appropriate analytical methods and modeling techniques for this purpose.
Analyze and design a system, system component, or process to meet desired requirements under realistic constraints; apply modern design methods accordingly.
Select and use modern techniques and tools necessary for engineering applications; effectively use information technologies and at least one computer software.
Design experiments, conduct experiments, collect data, analyze, and interpret results.
Access information and conduct research for this purpose, using databases and other information sources.
Work effectively individually and in multidisciplinary teams, taking responsibility.
Communicate effectively in Turkish verbally and in writing; possess at least B1 general level foreign language proficiency according to the European Language Portfolio.
Be aware of the necessity of lifelong learning; follow developments in science and technology and continuously update themselves.
Possess professional and ethical responsibility awareness.

syllabus_topics: Concept of frequency in image and frequency spectrum
Image sampling, aliasing, and conditions on sampling frequency
FIR filters, low-pass, high-pass, and band-pass filters
Methods for enhancing edges in images / 2-dimensional IIR Filters
Fundamentals of image processing, definitions and application examples
Image processing techniques, pixel operators and filtering methods
Image processing with Fourier transform, image compression and coding methods
Fundamentals of shape representation and description
Projective geometry, image warping and image blending techniques
Basic morphological operations and their applications
Fundamentals of line, corner and shape recognition
bibliography: GONZALES R.C., WOODS R.E., and ADDINS S.L., Digital Image Processing Using Matlab, Pearson Education Inc., New Jersey, 2004
LOW A., Introductory Computer Vision and Image Processing, McGrow-Hill, 1991, England
JAHNE B., Digital Image Processing, Springer-Verlag, 2005, Netherlands
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
